name: Pan African Resources PLC
source: CRON 20261013: FY2026 column added from Pan African Resources plc summarised audited results for the year ended 30 June 2026 (SENS announcement, 16 September 2026), group total column, US$ thousands: Revenue 1,156,451; cost of production 514,297; gross profit 642,154; other income 4,596; other expenses 85,958; impairment loss on non-financial assets 345; royalty costs 14,609; profit before finance income and finance costs (EBIT) 545,838; finance income 5,848; finance costs 17,318; profit before tax 534,368; income tax 177,457; profit for the year 356,911; EPS US 17.60 cents. Gates tie exactly: 1,156,451 less 514,297 equals 642,154; 642,154 less net operating costs 96,316 equals 545,838; 545,838 less net finance costs 11,470 equals 534,368; and 534,368 less 177,457 equals 356,911. FY2025 was restated in this pass to the same audited comparative column in that announcement (Revenue 540,033; cost of production 314,187; gross profit 225,846; EBIT 215,850; net finance costs 19,217; profit before tax 196,633; income tax 56,028; profit for the year 140,605; EPS US 7.16 cents): the stored FY2025 operating expenses, EBIT, net finance costs and net profit were secondary-feed values that did not match the audited statement, and FY2025 now ties the same way. FY2024 and earlier remain the secondary feed. Currency: US dollars. Net Profit is profit for the year, which is also profit attributable to owners (the group has no minority interest.)
